directAnswer: DLSS can significantly enhance image quality while maintaining performance, often providing a visual fidelity comparable to native resolution rendering at a lower computational cost.
summary: DLSS technology improves image quality in games by using AI to upscale lower resolution images, resulting in better performance without sacrificing visual fidelity.

sections.heading: Understanding DLSS
sections.body: DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) leverages artificial intelligence to upscale lower resolution images in real-time, allowing for higher frame rates without a noticeable drop in visual quality.

sections.heading: Performance Impact
sections.body: The performance impact of DLSS varies by game and hardware. Generally, it allows for higher frame rates at higher resolutions, making it cost-effective for gamers who want better performance.

steps.title: Enable DLSS in Game Settings
steps.detail: Navigate to the graphics settings in your game. Look for the DLSS option and enable it. The exact path may vary by game.

steps.title: Select DLSS Quality Mode
steps.detail: Choose the desired DLSS quality mode (Performance, Balanced, Quality) based on your preference for image quality versus performance.

faqs.question: Does DLSS work with all games?
faqs.answer: No, DLSS is only supported in games that have implemented the technology. Check the game's specifications for DLSS support.

faqs.question: Will DLSS affect my FPS?
faqs.answer: Yes, DLSS typically increases FPS by allowing the GPU to render at a lower resolution while still delivering high-quality visuals.

faqs.question: Is DLSS available on all GPUs?
faqs.answer: DLSS is primarily available on NVIDIA RTX GPUs. Check compatibility with your specific GPU model.

caveats: The effectiveness of DLSS can vary based on the game's implementation and the specific graphics settings used.
